entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your full name and order number to start?
Thank you, Mark. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the AeroShield helmet. And I also see you're a VIP member with us, we really appreciate your business.
Of course. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
The color is not what I expected. It looks completely different than the picture.
I see. So just to confirm, there are no issues with the safety features or fit, it's just the color?
Yes, that's what I said. The box is still unopened. I haven't even touched it.

Understood. Thank you for clarifying. Let me just check the return eligibility based on the delivery date... Okay, looks like it was delivered 74 days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return policy.

I've gone ahead and approved this return for you. I'm generating a prepaid return label to send to your email on file right now. And as a courtesy for you being a VIP member, I've waived the standard restocking fee.

It's on its way to your inbox now. Once our warehouse receives the item, you can expect a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No. I'm sure I'll just have to call back when the refund doesn't show up.
I'll put a note on the account to ensure it's processed smoothly for you, Mark. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a wonderful day.
